clusters.name: little
clusters.compatible_cpu_description: Cortex-A53-class Kryo 260 Silver cores; QEMU CPU model remains an approximation

clusters.name: big
clusters.compatible_cpu_description: Cortex-A73-class Kryo 260 Gold cores; QEMU CPU model remains an approximation

notes: MPIDR affinity values are transcribed from the public SoC DTSI CPU reg cells.
QEMU instantiates Cortex-A53/A72 architectural approximations with these MPIDR values; this is not Kryo 260 microarchitecture emulation.
Frequency/voltage scaling, Kryo-specific microarchitecture, cache hierarchy and Qualcomm power management are not emulated.

implementation.cpu_execution: QEMU Cortex-A53/A72 architectural approximations with SDM660 DTSI MPIDR affinity layout; not Kryo 260 microarchitecture
implementation.board_base: Native QEMU machine source; no generic virt board inheritance

peripherals.gic_timer_uart_psci: GICv3, architectural timers, UARTDM IRQ, and GICv3 maintenance PPI are wired; native DTB advertises PSCI and arm_load_kernel is configured for QEMU SMC PSCI; runtime CPU_ON/OFF remains unvalidated
